note: [L] bounds the non-coprime terms pointwise ($\sum_{(n,q)>1}\Lambda(n)\eta_+(n/x)\le10^{-15}x$) and inserts $D=10^{-15}x$ into the per-modulus residual (sum_residual_le), instead of integrating over $\mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$ with Cauchy-Schwarz and Plancherel; the $\Lambda^2$ sums and $\log r$ factor do not occur.

snippet.text:
/-- `|S_{η₊}(α) − S'_q(α)| ≤ 10⁻¹⁵ x`. -/
theorem norm_S_sub_coprime_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} (hq1 : 1 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ 300000)
    (α : ℝ) : ‖S etaPlus x α - expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) α‖ ≤ 1e-15 * x := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hc := summable_cP hx0
  have ha : Summable fun n => ‖coprimePart q (cP x) n‖ :=
    hc.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (norm_coprimePart_le q (cP x))
  rw [S_etaPlus_eq_expTsum, ← expTsum_sub hc ha]
  exact (norm_expTsum_le_tsum (summable_sub_coprimePart hx0 q) α).trans (coprime_split hx hq1 hq)

proof_context.conclusion: $|S_{\eta_+}(\alpha)-S'_q(\alpha)|\le10^{-15}x$ pointwise for all $\alpha$, covering the terms with $(n,q)>1$.
